parent_objective: audit M2368 consolidated target and guardrail artifacts before repair design
blocked_by: M2368 materializes consolidated artifacts but does not choose repair design route
target and guardrail artifacts require audit before any repair
supersedes: direct repair from unreviewed consolidated target rows
profile or pack ranking from diagnostic guardrail rows

public_gates: M2369 must audit M2368 summary, target counts, guardrail counts, and claim boundary without rerun
M2369 must identify the next bounded route or stop the branch
M2369 must keep ranking, winner selection, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits the consolidated target and guardrail panel materialized from M2365 slices
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, or training-repair claim
stop_condition: stop if M2368 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if diagnostic axes or R4 rows entered ordinary repair targets
stop if audit would route directly to training without repair-design constraints
stop if audit attempts profile or pack ranking
fallback_plan: route to consolidation schema repair if artifacts are inconsistent
route to bounded repair design if artifacts are accepted
route to branch synthesis if consolidated evidence is insufficient to choose a repair route
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2368 materializes consolidated target and guardrail artifacts

allowed_updates: M2369 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2368 artifacts are accepted or rejected
repair target, collision guardrail, R4, and diagnostic categories are summarized
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2369 audits target artifacts and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2369; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Weak consolidated outcomes should be routed as repair-design inputs, not interpreted as ranking evidence.
allowed_claims: artifact-only actionable target consolidation result audit
no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded repair design but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2369 cannot audit or route from target consolidation artifacts
M2369 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the outcome-localization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2368 consolidated target artifacts can decide the next bounded repair-design route without rerun, ranking, or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: M2368 target, guardrail, R4, and diagnostic counts are audited
diagnostic-axis and R4 ordinary repair-target exclusions are verified
ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2369 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2369 ranks support policies or controller families
M2369 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2369 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2369 cannot decide next route from complete consolidation artifacts

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2368 actionable target consolidation artifacts

decision_rule: M2369 passes if it audits M2368 consolidation artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
